_readme: Copy this file to config.json and fill in all values. GITHUB_TOKEN is NOT stored here — set it as an environment variable. restoreTestRepo is OPTIONAL — only consumed by `npm run verify:phase-4`. webhookHostname is REQUIRED — operator must point an A record at the droplet IP before `npm run bootstrap-droplet`. webhookTestRepo is OPTIONAL — only consumed by `npm run verify:phase-3`.
_comment_sources: Phase 6 multi-source. Each entry is either a bare string (just a github user/org name, no per-repo filtering) OR an object with optional repos.allow / repos.deny glob lists. Globs use bash case syntax (* ? [..]). ROADMAP SC#4: deny wins on conflict. ROADMAP SC#5: empty allow = all repos of source. A bare pattern like "foo-*" matches the repo basename; an "owner/name" pattern matches full_name verbatim.
_comment_legacy: githubUserOrOrg is still accepted as a legacy single-source field. If both fields are set, githubSources wins with a printed deprecation warning. The legacy line is also written to backup.env so a not-yet-upgraded droplet keeps working against source #1.
